extraction.notes: No qualifying summer 2027 or summer 2026 youth camp was found on the supplied official pages or the official classes, events and news listings found through search. The classes listing includes non-summer dates through April 2027, not a 2027 summer program list. A third-party-hosted PDF titled Summer Art Experience surfaced, but its contents could not be read and its season could not be verified; it was not used to create a card. The /classes URL returned no readable text; the actual classes listing was found at https://www.rcartguild.com/art-classes.
